title: Migrate development commands from Make to Take
description:
Migrated Make targets to Take and ran the official quickstart. Build commands, type-generation config, Dockerfile/ignore rules and GoReleaser config now live in .dev; dev.ts is the portable entrypoint, and binary output goes to dist/cloud-torrent. Removed Makefile and the redundant generate.go. Updated docs and agent instructions. GitHub Actions uses separate single-line Take calls for type checks, build, tests and releases; GoReleaser's frontend hook also calls Take. Kept frontend-local package configuration and GitHub-required workflow locations.

Validation: official quickstart greeting passed; Take check-types and full frontend/Go build passed, including invocation from /tmp; full Take Go test suite and aggregate ./dev.ts ci passed; Docker build --check passed; formatting and git diff --check passed. Release command help and GoReleaser action install-only input verified; no release published.
